text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why this exact Information Security Engineering role at Google is the applicant's intended next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in software or security work with little indication of why this specific role is the match."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in Google or security impact but ties that interest only loosely to the actual role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a plausible reason for interest tied to one clear aspect of the role, such as scale, security impact, or backend work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects the applicant's trajectory to several specific aspects of the role and makes the move feel well considered."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a compelling, individualized rationale that makes this role feel like a natural continuation of the applicant's past work and future goals."}]},{"name":"Mandate understanding","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of the team's work automating security processes, handling vulnerabilities, and supporting developers at scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the job as general software or security work without showing the specific mandate of the team."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation or Google scale in broad terms but captures only part of what the team is being asked to do."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Accurately references key duties such as vulnerability triage, agent tooling, or embedding security into development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames the role as systems work that scales security operations across many teams and throughout the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of the central challenge, including reducing manual expert toil through agentic tooling, automated handling, or similar high-leverage security infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Software experience","description":"How strong the letter's described professional experience is in building, maintaining, testing, and launching production software relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes the low end of the observed range, such as about three years of experience with limited scope across only a couple of production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows qualifying experience with some production ownership but still modest breadth of systems or tenure."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-range experience with multiple years of work and several production services maintained or launched."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong repeated ownership across multiple production services over roughly five to seven years of relevant work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents the top end of observed relevant experience, pairing lengthy tenure with broad and repeated responsibility for numerous production services."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter presents Go as a strong, relevant language for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go as one language used in production but gives little sense that it is central to the applicant's work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a regular working language yet provides limited evidence of depth or direct relevance to this role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a primary or frequent language in recent production experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a daily or dominant language for backend systems similar to those in the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Ties substantial Go experience directly to designing or operating the kinds of backend or control systems this role calls for."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Python capability relevant to automation and AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it so indirectly that real proficiency is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly without indicating meaningful recent use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States clear working use of Python for tooling, services, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a substantial day-to-day language for internal tooling, analysis, prototypes, or services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major strength with concrete production use in tooling, services, or agent implementations."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"How well the letter evidences hands-on experience building reliable AI-enabled software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without concrete implementation experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building AI or model-backed features but with limited detail about production use."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work and indicates attention to reliability, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong production AI experience and explicitly frames trustworthy deployment as part of the work."}]},{"name":"Agent design","description":"How convincingly the letter shows experience designing systems that combine agents with surrounding control infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of agentic or autonomous tooling work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to agents only vaguely or as an area of interest rather than demonstrated experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building agentic tooling or multi-step autonomous pipelines."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a clear architecture in which agents operate within services or infrastructure the applicant designed."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents mature agent-system design with explicit constraints, supervision, auditability, or permissions around agent behavior."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no concrete vulnerability workflow automation example."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation generally but not a specific vulnerability-report process."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant automated vulnerability intake or triage at a basic descriptive level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete pipeline for classifying, routing, or prioritizing vulnerability reports that reduced manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents strong, specific vulnerability-handling automation with features such as deduplication, ownership routing, or clearly returned expert time."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"How well the letter shows the applicant can perform structured security reviews or assessments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no clear evidence of conducting security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies security awareness but does not describe actual assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States participation in security assessments, reviews, or threat modeling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on assessment practices such as attack-surface mapping, code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature assessment capability that combines concrete methods, attacker-minded analysis, and follow-through beyond checklist review."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates strength with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention algorithmic work or offers only a vague claim of technical strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions data structures or algorithms without a concrete example of applied use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one credible example of algorithmic improvement or redesign."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong applied algorithmic thinking through a specific example with clear system impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic fluency a standout strength, using a compelling example to show elegant and high-leverage system improvement."}]},{"name":"Platform orientation","description":"How strongly the letter aligns the applicant with backend, infrastructure, or centrally leveraged systems work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little evidence of interest in backend or infrastructure work beyond general software engineering."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions backend or foundational work in passing without showing it as a clear fit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear backend-service experience and interest in infrastructure-adjacent problems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Emphasizes platform, internal tooling, or foundational systems whose value is multiplied across teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes centrally leveraged infrastructure work a core part of the applicant's identity and directly connects it to this team."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as helping other engineers move faster and more safely.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about serving developers or reducing friction for other teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams in general terms without a clear philosophy of enablement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that tooling or defaults should make secure behavior easier for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames security as developer-facing systems work that reduces toil and avoids policing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently presents the applicant's approach as scaling scarce security expertise by making secure development the path of least resistance."}]},{"name":"Security practice","description":"How much independent security practice the letter shows beyond routine software development claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no signal of independent security practice outside ordinary work responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a baseline signal such as a basic certification or casual capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful extra security engagement through a stronger certification, regular capture-the-flag work, or offensive-minded habits."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates serious security practice through OSCP, strong competitive capture-the-flag participation, or similarly credible signals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals of active security practice, such as advanced certification plus high-level capture-the-flag performance or sustained attacker-minded work."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter signals careful engineering around correctness, constraints, auditability, and dependable operation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes building systems with little mention of checks, boundaries, or operational rigor."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at quality-mindedness but gives few concrete signs of rigorous engineering."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some concern for dependable behavior through guardrails, testing, careful design language, or safe deployment."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly emphasizes reliability through contracts, audits, checks, bounded actions, or similar mechanisms."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes rigorous and trustworthy system behavior a defining theme and backs it with concrete examples of constraints, evaluation, or safe operation."}]},{"name":"Impact orientation","description":"How clearly the letter shows that the applicant's work produced meaningful results for systems or teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly lists technologies or duties without describing what changed because of the work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests beneficial results but leaves them abstract or weakly evidenced."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes some recognizable outcomes such as saved time, removed bottlenecks, or improved workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly connects past work to tangible improvements in capacity, performance, reliability, or team effectiveness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes high-leverage outcomes central to the case, clearly showing how the work changed scale, speed, or expert workload."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete and substantiated the letter's claims are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mainly on abstract claims, slogans, or self-description with little supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics such as tool names or certifications but leaves many major claims unsubstantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete examples, systems, or tasks."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses specific and believable examples to substantiate most important qualifications."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Grounds nearly every key claim in concrete examples, architectures, problems, or projects."}]},{"name":"External initiative","description":"How much the letter adds credible evidence of self-driven technical work beyond core job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no supplementary evidence from side projects, open source, or other self-directed work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a modest personal project or occasional external contribution with little depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a sustained side project or recurring upstream contribution that adds useful credibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents substantial self-driven work such as maintaining used open-source software, regular patches, or technically ambitious personal builds."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides standout extra-role evidence that materially strengthens the application, such as widely used open-source stewardship or ambitious systems projects with hard engineering tradeoffs."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or typographical errors distract throughout and materially weaken credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several noticeable errors appear and somewhat disrupt reading, even though the message remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Occasional errors are present but the prose remains generally professional and easy to follow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The writing is clean and polished with only minor slips, if any."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The prose is virtually error-free and consistently polished at the sentence level."}]},{"name":"Readability","description":"How well the letter organizes information into a clear and persuasive progression.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The case is hard to follow because the ideas feel poorly ordered, abrupt, or loosely connected."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"A basic structure is present but the flow is uneven or sections read like disconnected points."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is logically ordered and readable, though some transitions or emphasis could be stronger."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The structure guides the reader smoothly from motivation to evidence to fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is especially coherent and easy to scan, with crisp progression and strong paragraph-level purpose."}]}]}
